INSERT INTO git_sync_synced_head
            (workspace_id, repo_resource_path, branch, sha, source, job_id)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
         ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, repo_resource_path, branch, sha)
         DO UPDATE SET source = EXCLUDED.source, job_id = EXCLUDED.job_id, synced_at = now()
